name: Kenny Bee
bio: Chung Chun-To (Chinese: 鐘鎮濤, born 23 February 1953), also known by his stage name Kenny Bee, is a Hong Kong singer, musician and actor. He is best known as the singer of the group the Wynners, and as a solo artist who has been active in the Hong Kong entertainment industry for nearly three decades.
